description: Veriflow Catalog-to-Browser Automation Mapping Index linking production test catalog IDs to automated browser journeys.

mappings.name: Valid credentials login journey
mappings.preconditions: Application has login form and authenticated dashboard destination.

mappings.name: Invalid credentials error handling
mappings.preconditions: Login page renders visible error banner upon bad credentials.

mappings.name: Nonexistent account error and registration link
mappings.preconditions: System distinguishes or guides nonexistent accounts toward registration.

mappings.name: Logout session invalidation and back-button rejection
mappings.preconditions: Authenticated user can log out and invalidate cookie/token.

mappings.name: Session persistence across page reload
mappings.preconditions: Session persists across F5 / page reload.

mappings.name: Protected route unauthenticated rejection
mappings.preconditions: Protected routes redirect to login when unauthenticated.

mappings.name: Primary navbar links navigation
mappings.preconditions: Navigation header contains functional internal links.

mappings.name: Browser back and forward traversal
mappings.preconditions: Application history reflects discrete route transitions.

mappings.name: Unknown route 404 page and recovery
mappings.preconditions: Server or SPA renders friendly 404 on unmapped routes.

mappings.name: Required fields client validation
mappings.preconditions: Form has required attributes or client validation.

mappings.name: Long boundary input handling
mappings.preconditions: Input accepts length boundaries without crash.

mappings.name: Keyboard Enter submission
mappings.preconditions: Form submits upon pressing Enter in input.

mappings.name: Mobile viewport reflow and overflow check
Browser console error collection
mappings.preconditions: Page runs without uncaught JavaScript exceptions.

mappings.name: Failed network request collection
mappings.preconditions: Page does not trigger 4xx/5xx network failures.
